title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (Late Show) on 1970-02-13
source: 2-source matrix mix of shnid #97639(SBD) and shnid #123814(AUD)

ai_review.summary: High‑quality matrix recording captures a legendary late‑show jam with a soaring Dark Star → Other One → Lovelight sequence and crisp sound that lets the magic shine.
ai_review.review: The show is hailed as a classic, especially for its extended Dark Star > Other One > Lovelight stretch that many reviewers describe as life‑changing.  The matrix source provides clear, bright audio (some users added a touch of bass/reverb to tame the brightness) and preserves the audience’s reverent atmosphere, making it one of the more listenable documents of this era.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews are 5‑star, praising both performance and sound; only one modestly critical comment exists, yielding a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and bright matrix mix; some listeners note slight brightness that they soften with added bass/reverb, but overall the sound is crisp and far superior to straight audience tapes.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A powerful late‑show set with a long, immersive second half; the Dark Star > Other One > Lovelight sequence is highlighted for its intensity and the audience’s hushed reverence.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised as being in his prime with soaring guitar tone during the jams.
